q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution

Today is 2026-08-16. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings call is scheduled for August 26, 2026 — **10 days away**. The forward guidance will be provided at that earnings release. This is a very short-duration forecast with minimal uncertainty window.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

The research explicitly states that NVIDIA has **already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027**: **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**.

This guidance was issued on May 20, 2026 during the Q1 FY2027 earnings release. The guidance range is therefore:
- Lower bound: $91.0B × 0.98 = $89.18B
- Upper bound: $91.0B × 1.02 = $92.82B

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or maintain this guidance when they report Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026. Companies typically provide forward guidance once per quarter and reaffirm it unless material circumstances change.

Given that:
- Only 10 days remain until the earnings call
- The guidance was just issued ~3 months ago (May 20 to August 16)
- No major disruptions or changes are mentioned in the research
- NVIDIA's business trajectory appears stable (Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B showed strong growth)

The guidance of $91.0B ± 2% is almost certain to be reaffirmed.

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

- **Major adverse geopolitical event**: Expanded China restrictions or new export controls could reduce data center revenue
- **Demand softening**: If capacity buildout slowed more than expected between May and August
- **Competitive pressure**: If new competitors gained significant market share
- **Macro downturn**: Severe economic contraction affecting capex spending
- However, none of these appear likely in the 10-day window remaining

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

- **Better-than-expected demand**: If customer demand accelerated beyond May expectations
- **China upside surprise**: If China Data Center revenue could be included (though guidance explicitly excludes this)
- **Strong Q1 execution outperformance**: Beating revenue could inspire optimism
- **New product revenue**: If new products shipped ahead of schedule
- Again, unlikely to materialize in 10 days given guidance was recent

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

The research provides the explicit data point: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** was NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 forward guidance as of May 20, 2026.

Historical context from the research:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6B (up 20% QoQ, 85% YoY)
- Expected Q2 guidance: $91.0B (implies ~11.5% sequential growth)

This sequential growth rate is reasonable given NVIDIA's trajectory and aligns with their capacity/production ramp.

---

## Probability Assessment

Given that:
1. Forward guidance was **already provided** ~3 months ago at $91.0B ± 2%
2. Only 10 days remain until the August 26 earnings call
3. No material changes reported in the intervening period
4. Companies typically reaffirm recent guidance unless circumstances materially change

The guidance will almost certainly fall within the $89.18B–$92.82B range, with the central expectation at $91.0B.

The question asks: "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?"

This is asking for the guidance that will be **announced on August 26, 2026** (or already provided). Since guidance was already issued at $91.0B ± 2%, this is the expected outcome.

The center of the given range (99.5–115.5B) is 107.5B, which is **substantially higher** than the stated guidance of 91.0B. The question range appears to be either:
- Asking about actual Q2 results (not guidance)
- Or misaligned with the actual guidance

However, the research is explicit: forward guidance = $91.0B ± 2%.

**My estimate is concentrated at $91.0 billion**, with small probability mass for slight upward or downward revisions.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (Q2 FY2027) with its Q1 FY2027 earnings release on May 20, 2026. The company expects Q2 FY2027 revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-For-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-For-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and 85% from a year ago [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-For-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The company is scheduled to host a conference call to discuss its Q2 FY2027 financial results on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
